content.title: SANDALS® All-Inclusive Honeymoon Packages In Antigua
content.text: HONEYMOON IN Antigua HONEYMOONS AT THE MOST ROMANTIC RESORT IN THE WORLD Antigua is one of the Caribbean’s most scenic destinations for newlyweds. This tropical paradise is home to over 365 white sand beaches set along some of the most pristine blue waters on the planet. Honeymooners can enjoy everything Antigua has to offer from sun-kissed relaxation on the island’s best beaches to world-class cuisine, romantic honeymoon suites, and a world of adventure through unlimited land and water sports.View sandals resorts in Antigua Free Antigua Honeymoon PackageA Bubbly Welcome: a bottle of chilled sparkling wine elegantly arranged in your room to toast your future.A Romantic Gesture: a special turndown service that includes flower petals on your bed on the first evening of your honeymoon.Wake Up to Wedded Bliss: delight in a delivery of fresh flowers and a decadent breakfast in bed one morning of your choice.Travel must take place within 30 days of your wedding date. Find The Right Sandals For Youfind your sandals FAQs About Jamaica HONEYMOONSIs Antigua a good honeymoon destination? Antigua is the perfect honeymoon destination for newlyweds. With romantic white sand beaches, stunning viewpoints and luxurious honeymoon packages, there's much to enjoy at this tropical island country. Go on a sunset cruise around the island, while sipping on a rum-infused cocktail. It doesn't get better than this!Where should I honeymoon in Antigua? Sandals Grande Antigua was voted the "World's Most Romantic Resort" year after year and was specifically designed for couples in love. The beautiful resort grounds, the privileged location on Dickenson Bay, amazing spa amenities, enchanting fire pits and the excellent gourmet restaurants make it the perfect honeymoon getaway!How long is the average honeymoon in Antigua? A typical honeymoon in Antigua lasts 7 to 9 days, but when budget allows, some couples choose to stay longer. Take the time to enjoy your newlywed status and don’t cause unnecessary stress by rushing from one destination to another. Interested in visiting multiple Sandals Resorts? Go for a ‘Honeymoon Hop’!What are the things to do when on a honeymoon in Antigua? Enjoy a luxurious honeymoon resort in Antigua, and plan a few half day excursions. Depending on where you'll be staying, have a cocktail on the beach or at the swim-up bar, organize a private candlelight dinner and go for a couples massage. Outside the resort, go on a sunset catamaran cruise, enjoy an eco tour around the island, take a local cooking class and snorkel amongst stingrays at Stingray City. See more things to do in Antigua.What to pack for a honeymoon in Antigua? Packing for a honeymoon in Antigua? Don't forget to bring loads of sunscreen, shoes for hiking, a waterproof bag, and snorkeling gear if needed (Sandals provides snorkeling gear free of charge to their guests). Besides beachwear, bring some nice clothing for a romantic dinner or even a photoshoot on the beach.HoneymoonDestinationsSaint Vincent Jamaica Saint Lucia Antigua Bahamas Grenada Barbados Curaçao Get Started EnglishEspañolPortuguês
